subject: BridgePlay pilot - steward rotation & implementation runway
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Jenkins <sara.jenkins@lifepointhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: BridgePlay pilot - steward rotation & implementation runway

Team — looping you in to transition Lifepoint's BridgePlay pilot into CS ownership. Quick summary up front:
- ARR: $185k ARR with a 3-month pilot leading to a Q3 expansion decision.
- Objective: Validate inference latency and content safety filters in production-like traffic (healthcare PII workload).
- Expected pilot start: 2027-05-16 (staging week of 05/09).

Key asks:
1) Monica: primary CS steward for pilot (owner for customer success metrics & weekly sync).
2) Tessa: onboarding lead (training cadence, enablement docs).
3) Ben: technical lead for staging and go-live (connectors, VPC access, SSO).

Notes & constraints from sales/POC:
- Customer requires SAML SSO + SCIM provisioning.
- Deployment: preference for Private (VPC) with VPN peering; they may request an on-prem connector later.
- Data retention requirement: 90 days logs + audit export for SOC2 review.
- Latency target for pilot: P95 < 250ms. Budget flagged for Dedicated capacity if we need stable throughput.

Attachments: Lifepoint_SOW_v1.pdf, mutual_action_plan.xlsx (stub). I linked the DocuSign envelope below for the signed SOW.

Suggested next steps: 1) Internal kickoff 4/27 10:00 PT (30m) to review runbook & owners, 2) Pre-staging tech check 5/6. Please confirm owners and any missing compliance asks.

Thanks —
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BridgePlay pilot - steward rotation & implementation runway

Thanks Jonas — I can take primary CS stewardship. Quick allocation / immediate asks: 
- I'll own weekly success metrics (engagement, accuracy, escalation triage).
- Tessa will run enablement: 2x 60m training sessions (staging + go-live), and own the customer playbook.
- Ben: can you confirm dedicated GPU needs? Sales mentioned 2x A10 equivalence during pilot for stable P95 testing — if true we need to provision staging capacity by 5/6.

Operational constraints I flagged for Lifepoint:
- Security review requires an engineer to complete our SOC2 evidence checklist and provide a network diagram.
- They asked for a rolling export of audit logs (CSV) for first 30 days post-go-live.

I'll draft a short runbook and share an internal pre-kickoff checklist. I've attached a lightweight staging runbook I use as a template (runbook-staging-checklist.md).

Proposed internal kickoff: Tue 4/27 10:00 PT — I can host. Jonas, please add procurement contact (we should confirm payment start date aligns with pilot window).

Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

Thanks Jonas & Monica — appreciate the clear notes. Quick confirmations from our side: 
- Procurement: we'll review the DocuSign envelope today and aim to confirm by 4/28.
- SSO: our identity team confirms SAML + SCIM is supported; they may share metadata by 05/03.
- VPN peering: network wants a short window for testing; can you propose a staging peering slot 5/6-5/7?
- Pilot contacts: Sara Jenkins (prod owner), Greg Miles (security) greg.miles@lifepointhealth.com (cc'd in internal thread later).

Preferred go-live: 2027-05-16, but flexible +1 week if we need more staging time. We appreciate the audit-export option for SOC review.

Sara

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BridgePlay pilot - steward rotation & implementation runway

Thanks — technical checklist and immediate asks below. Quoting Sara for visibility on staging windows.

Staging checklist (short):
- Confirm A10-equivalent provisioning (requested: 2x A10) — Ops, please approve capacity by 5/4 so we can schedule peering.
- Provide SAML metadata and SCIM attributes (Sara said by 05/03).
- Provide a test dataset (PII-masked) and sample traffic pattern (QPS / avg token length).
- Create a staging VPC and open a /29 for the VPN peer; provide IPs to networking team.
- API keys: generate a staging API key with read/write token-level logging enabled.
- Telemetry: define 3 success metrics (latency P95, correctness by rubric, safety filter false positives).

I'll start a short tech runbook in the repo and attach the staging checklist. If Ops can't approve Dedicated capacity, we should plan to run a synthetic load test with burst windows.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
